name: himself65/finance-skills
description: A plugin collection of finance skills grouped by provider and analysis type, including market analysis, data providers, and social readers. The verified sample is a read-only Fintel data skill that queries the Fintel API and MCP endpoint with a user-supplied key. Other groups include sentiment, trading-view readers, and hyperliquid data. Note: Requires user-supplied API credentials for external data access.
install: npx plugins add himself65/finance-skills and per-skill form npx skills add himself65/finance-skills --skill yfinance-data. A codex plugin marketplace route is also documented.
